name: tubeai-skills
description: The TubeAI plugin for Claude Code: a video editor for YouTube creators, with optional research from TubeAI.

plugins.name: tubeai
plugins.description: A video editor for YouTube creators in Claude Code, on Mac or Windows: Claude sets up a Remotion project, keeps each channel's branding and reusable animations, matches styles from a YouTube link or video file, researches media, makes Qwen3-TTS voiceovers and verbatim transcripts, edits raw recordings into a Premiere, Final Cut or Resolve timeline with zooms and pans on the speaker and a mastered voice, and renders on the GPU. Optional: connect TubeAI to research 400M+ YouTube videos for ideas, packaging, transcripts and thumbnails. Made for non-technical users.
